quick_skim.title: NashDreamer: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
quick_skim.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable results in single-agent domains, yet its extension to competitive imperfect information games (IIGs) remains underexplored. In multi-agent settings, opponent-induced non-stationarity complicates the learning process, and decentralized model learning faces severe identifiability barriers, which we argue make centralized model learning a mathematical necessity. Building on this analysis, we propose NashDreamer, a principled MBRL framework for two-player zero-sum IIGs. It introduces a centralized Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model (MARSSM) that decouples environment dynamics from the effect of players' strategies on their individual observations. NashDreamer is designed to use arbitrary policy gradient algorithms and inherits their convergence guarantees towards Nash equilibria under an idealized model. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark games demonstrate that NashDreamer substantially improves sample efficiency over model-free baselines early in the training. Finally, we theoretically analyze the architecture's optimization landscape, identifying the vulnerability of the Dreamer family of algorithms to posterior collapse in stochastic environments. We leave it as an open challenge.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: MBRL framework for two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games; pursuit-evasion can be framed as such a game
quick_skim.llm_evidence_cn: 提出两玩家零和不完全信息博弈的基于模型强化学习框架，逼近追逃博弈的均衡策略学习需求

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Introduces centralized multi-agent recurrent state-space model and NashDreamer MBRL for two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games, targeting non-stationarity and identifiability issues with strong results in comparison to model-free baselines.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 基于模型的强化学习主要面向单智能体，难以直接用于追逃等竞争性不完全信息博弈。作者提出NashDreamer，引入去耦环境动态与对手策略影响的集中式多智能体循环状态空间模型，从学习的世界模型中规划并计算近似纳什策略。该方法解决了对手导致非平稳与分散模型不可辨识问题，在多个不完全信息博弈中表现显著优于无模型基线，为无人机追逃博弈策略学习提供一种可迁移的基于模型框架。
quick_skim.llm_tldr: 基于模型的强化学习主要面向单智能体，难以直接用于追逃等竞争性不完全信息博弈。作者提出NashDreamer，引入去耦环境动态与对手策略影响的集中式多智能体循环状态空间模型，从学习的世界模型中规划并计算近似纳什策略。该方法解决了对手导致非平稳与分散模型不可辨识问题，在多个不完全信息博弈中表现显著优于无模型基线，为无人机追逃博弈策略学习提供一种可迁移的基于模型框架。
